strings.styx.title: Styx Station
strings.styx.tagline: You wake up alone in a station drowned in black fog. Between dead clocks, endless platforms, and a black ticket, everything gives the impression that you’ve arrived in a place that watches and sorts its travelers.
strings.styx.s01.title: Waking on the Platform
strings.styx.s01.body:
You fall asleep on a night train... and wake with a start. The car is motionless. The doors are open. No station noise. Beyond the windows: black fog sliding low along the rails.

Your phone no longer shows the time. Just a ghost notification: "Last departure: unknown."
strings.styx.s01.c1: Stand up and look down the aisle
strings.styx.s02.title: Empty Car
strings.styx.s02.body:
The seats are worn, still warm in places, as if the passengers vanished just moments ago. The pale neon lights hum. A smell of cold dust clings to the fabric.

Everything is far too quiet for an arrival.
strings.styx.s02.c3: Head toward the other end of the car
strings.styx.s03.title: Total Silence
strings.styx.s03.body:
You hold your breath and listen. No footsteps, no announcement, no wind. The train seems to be holding its breath.

Then, very far away, a faint clinking... like a bell being brushed.
strings.styx.s03.c3: Search for the source of the sound
strings.styx.s04.title: The Black Ticket
strings.styx.s04.body:
On a seat lies a matte black ticket. No destination. No number. It absorbs the light like a piece of night.

When you touch it, your fingers turn instantly cold.
strings.styx.s04.c2: Hide it on yourself, then head to the ticket window
strings.styx.s05.title: Draft of Air
strings.styx.s05.body:
A breath of air moves through the car, cold and dry, as if the station were inhaling through the open doors.

In the window, your reflection lags half a second behind. You blink: it returns to normal.
strings.styx.s05.c2: Go back to the seat with the ticket
strings.styx.s06.title: STYX
strings.styx.s06.body:
You step onto the platform. The sign is old, cracked, yet still readable: "STYX."

Black fog crawls between the ties. A monumental station rises around you... empty, as if frozen in waiting.
strings.styx.s07.title: The Platform Measures You
strings.styx.s07.body:
The farther you go, the longer the platform seems to stretch. The cold lights stay at the same distance, as if the station refuses to let you get closer.

At the far end, one clear feeling: someone is there. Not visible. Present.
strings.styx.s07.c1: Keep going toward the end of the platform
strings.styx.s07.c3: Go back to the waiting room
strings.styx.s08.title: Destinations
strings.styx.s08.body:
The departure board flickers. Four words appear, like station names: "Lethe," "Acheron," "Phlegethon," "Hades — Restricted Access."

One line, lower down, flashes now and then... then disappears before you can read it.
strings.styx.s08.c1: Stare at the words and memorize them
strings.styx.s08.c3: Step back, the fog is following you
strings.styx.h.s08.soft: The board doesn’t inform: it sorts. The flashing line looks like an exception.
strings.styx.h.s08.strong: The board does not show everything to everyone.
strings.styx.s09.body:
The clock is enormous. Its hands are stopped at 03:17. Dust hangs motionless in the air.

You understand that this time is not random.
strings.styx.s09.c1: Carve the time into your memory
strings.styx.s09.c2: Look for an access point near the clock
strings.styx.h.s09.soft: A frozen station still has a rule. The stopped time is part of it.
strings.styx.h.s09.strong: That time matters. You’d better remember it.
strings.styx.s10.title: Closed Ticket Window
strings.styx.s10.body: The ticket window is shut. A brass bell waits on the counter. Behind the dusty glass, no clerk, but a lamp is lit... as if someone were working without showing themselves.
strings.styx.h.s10.soft: Everything here answers to simple rituals. Not explanations.
strings.styx.h.s10.strong: The ticket window answers rituals, not questions.
strings.styx.s11.title: The Bell
strings.styx.s11.body:
The bell is cold. You notice a detail engraved underneath: a small black-wave symbol, almost worn away.

Behind the glass, a shadow passes... too slow to be a reflection.
strings.styx.h.s11.soft: The station is not empty. It’s hiding.
strings.styx.h.s11.strong: The ticket window and the board seem connected.
strings.styx.s12.title: Torn Ticket
strings.styx.s12.body:
On the cracked marble floor, a black ticket is already torn in half. As if someone tried to cancel their passage... and failed.

The two halves almost pull toward each other, like magnets.
strings.styx.h.s12.soft: Here, tearing is not enough. The rules still stick to you.
strings.styx.h.s12.strong: Do not leave without keeping a trace of the ticket.
strings.styx.s13.title: Waiting Room
strings.styx.s13.body:
The waiting room is a ruined temple: cracked marble, broken statues, empty benches. The air smells of cold stone.

On one wall, fresh finger marks appear in the dust... then stop abruptly.
strings.styx.s14.title: The Marks
strings.styx.s14.body:
The finger marks lead into a dark corner... where nothing waits. No door. No passage.

Except for one word scratched in the dust: "RETURN."
strings.styx.s14.c2: Go toward a statue farther away
strings.styx.s15.title: Hades Is Watching You
strings.styx.s15.body:
A statue of Hades stands dark and intact amid the ruins. Its face has no detail, yet you feel its judgment.

At its base, a relief: a train plunging underground like into a river.
strings.styx.s16.title: Endless Platform
strings.styx.s16.body:
The platform stretches through the black fog with no end. The cold lamps repeat the exact same halo.

Far away, a figure seems to be waiting at the edge of sight.
strings.styx.s16.c3: Fix your eyes on the figure
strings.styx.s17.title: Figure
strings.styx.s17.body:
The figure does not move. It has no face. Just a posture, like someone waiting for the end of an inspection.

When you blink, it is closer.
strings.styx.s18.title: Red Glow
strings.styx.s18.body:
Far away, a train sits in a red glow cutting through the fog. It doesn’t seem to shine: it seems to burn.

A feeling tightens in your chest: that train is not a departure. It is an arrival.
strings.styx.s19.title: The Windows Lie
strings.styx.s19.body:
Back in the car, you find the same silence. But the windows no longer reflect the station: they reflect a platform full of shadows.

When you turn around... the car is empty again.
strings.styx.s19.c1: Go back to the center of the car
strings.styx.s19.c3: Close your eyes for one second
strings.styx.s20.title: The Conductor
strings.styx.s20.body:
Under a single lamp stands a conductor in uniform. His face is swallowed by shadow. He looks at you without really looking at you.

His voice is calm: "Ticket. Destination. Reason."
strings.styx.s21.title: Three Questions
strings.styx.s21.body:
The conductor does not move. "You are not supposed to get off here. Or maybe you are."

He tilts his head: "Prove it."
strings.styx.s21.c2: Say that you accept your fate
strings.styx.s21.c3: Claim it’s a misunderstanding and leave
strings.styx.s22.title: Stairs to the Basement
strings.styx.s22.body:
A staircase leads down to a basement. The walls are damp. The black fog grows denser and clings to the steps.

An inscription scratched on the railing: "ACHERON."
strings.styx.s22.c3: Go back to the waiting room
strings.styx.s23.title: The Steps
strings.styx.s23.body:
The farther you descend, the more the sound changes. Above: silence. Below: a slow trickling, like a river that does not want to be heard.

The cold becomes serious.
strings.styx.s23.c3: Climb back up despite the sense of failure
strings.styx.s24.title: ACHERON
strings.styx.s24.body:
The tunnel is marked "ACHERON" in damp letters. Black water pools on the floor. Every step makes a sound that does not belong to you.

You feel this passage leads to a point of no return.
strings.styx.h.s24.soft: The tunnel has a name: like a station. Like a judgment.
strings.styx.h.s24.strong: Don’t get lost: if you have no proof, going back is your only chance.
strings.styx.s25.title: Black Water
strings.styx.s25.body:
The water blackens reflections. Your shoes turn cold, numb. A smell of old metal hangs in the air.

Far away, a faint lantern glow.
strings.styx.s25.c1: Approach the source of the breath
strings.styx.s25.c2: Stay at the edge of the water
strings.styx.s25.c3: Go back to the beginning of the tunnel
strings.styx.s26.title: Walkway
strings.styx.s26.body:
A narrow walkway crosses an underground black river. The fog is thicker above the water.

The metal under your feet trembles slightly, almost alive.
strings.styx.s27.title: In the Middle
strings.styx.s27.body:
At the center of the walkway, you feel as if you are being judged. Not by a gaze, but by an invisible rule.

Your heart beats too hard, as if it wants to prove something.
strings.styx.s28.title: Lethe
strings.styx.s28.body:
A basin of black water, perfectly still. No ripple. No reflection of you... only a smooth surface.

One word is carved into the stone: "LETHE."
strings.styx.s28.c3: Step back, it may already be too late
strings.styx.h.s28.soft: This water does not drown: it erases.
strings.styx.h.s28.strong: Do not drink. If you give in, you will lose your proof, and with it your exit.
strings.styx.s29.title: The Water’s Call
strings.styx.s29.body:
The basin seems to whisper your name without sound. Your memories grow blurry around the edges, like a photograph slowly burning.

One more step, and you know you could forget why you are fighting.
strings.styx.s29.c1: Give in and drink a sip
strings.styx.s29.c3: Come back to the basin later
strings.styx.h.s29.strong: Resisting keeps you lucid. Giving in makes you lose useful flags.
strings.styx.s30.title: After
strings.styx.s30.body:
Your breath returns. But something has changed.

You feel that your state has shifted: either you held on, or something came loose from you and stayed in the water.
strings.styx.s30.c1: Look for an exit from Lethe
strings.styx.s30.c3: Go back to the basin’s edge
strings.styx.s31.title: Going Back Up
strings.styx.s31.body:
You turn around in the tunnel. Behind you, the water makes no sound.

It feels as though it never stopped waiting for you.
strings.styx.s31.c2: Go back through the waiting room
strings.styx.s32.title: HADES
strings.styx.s32.body:
The massive door is marked "HADES." A red glow seeps from beneath it. It does not flicker: it breathes.

You hear a distant rumble... like three breaths layered together.
strings.styx.s32.c2: Follow the glow around the side
strings.styx.s33.title: Restricted Access
strings.styx.s33.body:
Two statues block the door. You understand the message without reading it: only certain people pass.

The fog, however, seems allowed.
strings.styx.s33.c3: Go back to the previous door
strings.styx.s34.title: The Three-Headed Shadow
strings.styx.s34.body: On the wall, a gigantic shadow: a three-headed dog, but with no visible body. The light throws this threat across the wall, as if the place wants to warn you before what comes next.
strings.styx.s35.title: The Red Train Draws Closer
strings.styx.s35.body:
The red glow grows. An ancient train moves forward without sound, as if gliding on air.

Its doors bear no signs. Only scratch marks.
strings.styx.s35.c3: Go back to the cracked marble
strings.styx.s36.title: Empty Cab
strings.styx.s36.body:
You find an old driver’s cab, empty. Metal levers, analog dials. Everything is dark.

A seat waits for you. Too clean. Too centered. As if it had been kept for someone.
strings.styx.s36.c1: Go in and examine the levers
strings.styx.s36.c2: Leave the cab and follow a maintenance door
strings.styx.s37.title: Control Stand
strings.styx.s37.body:
Finger marks cover the console. As if someone drove recently.

An empty slot sits off to the side: the exact shape of a cap.
strings.styx.s37.c2: Return to the control stand with the cap
strings.styx.s38.title: Black Cap
strings.styx.s38.body:
A driver’s cap, black, left alone. No badge. No name.

When you take it, a cold authority runs through you.
strings.styx.s38.c1: Keep it in your hand and return to the control room
strings.styx.s39.title: Control Room
strings.styx.s39.body:
An abandoned rail control room. Analog screens, levers, technical panels. Everything is dusty... except for one clean button, as if often pressed.

A notebook rests near a console.
strings.styx.h.s39.soft: Here, the station admits it is still operating.
strings.styx.h.s39.strong: A control log could count as proof: search the console.
strings.styx.s40.title: The Console
strings.styx.s40.body:
The console has compartments. Some are empty. Some carry names... but the letters blur as soon as you focus on them.

One slot, however, stays clear: "RETURN — CANCELED."
strings.styx.s41.title: No Map Found
strings.styx.s41.body:
You find no map. Only technical signs leading nowhere. It feels like the station does not want to be understood.

At the back, a door leads to the cab.
strings.styx.s42.title: The Service Log
strings.styx.s42.body:
The notebook is a control log. Plain lines: schedules, passages, inspections.

The last entry is fresh: "STYX — Inspection: IN PROGRESS." And just below: "Exception: RETURN — proof required."
strings.styx.h.s42.soft: The station admits an exception: the exit exists.
strings.styx.h.s42.strong: Keep that log. With 03:17 + the return line + the ticket, you can trigger the ending.
strings.styx.s43.title: A Button Too Clean
strings.styx.s43.body:
A button bears a faded label. When you bring your hand near it, you hear what sounds like a distant voice saying: "Another one."

You do not press it... but you know it has been used before.
strings.styx.s44.title: Lever
strings.styx.s44.body:
A lever is locked. A safety mechanism requires "driving authorization."

You look at your hands. You have nothing that looks like authorization... except maybe a cap.
strings.styx.s45.title: Cab Lit Up
strings.styx.s45.body:
The cab lights up. A cold light. The dials come alive.

The main lever waits. Very far away, you hear a platform full of still shadows.
strings.styx.h.s45.soft: The cab is not a tool: it is a role.
strings.styx.h.s45.strong: If you activate the cab with the cap, you open the path to the secret ending.
strings.styx.s46.title: The Station Responds
strings.styx.s46.body:
A rumble rolls through the walls. The rails vibrate. You have triggered something.

You feel a rule apply to you now: if you drive, you become responsible for arrivals.
strings.styx.s46.c3: Stop everything and return to the room
strings.styx.s47.title: Back on the Platform
strings.styx.s47.body:
On your way back, you notice the lights seem a little lower. As if the station were moving closer to you.

The conductor is here, somewhere. Even if you cannot see him.
strings.styx.s48.title: He Hasn’t Moved
strings.styx.s48.body:
The conductor has not changed position. His face remains a blank space.

He repeats: "Prove it." As if it were the only sentence he can say.
strings.styx.s49.title: The Protocol
strings.styx.s49.body:
He points to three things without naming them: a time, a line, a ticket.

You understand: the exit is not a right. It is an administrative exception.
strings.styx.s50.title: The Time
strings.styx.s50.body:
You say: "03:17."

The conductor inclines his head. For the first time, the air moves. "Go on."
strings.styx.s50.c1: Give the time to the conductor
strings.styx.s51.title: The Return Line
strings.styx.s51.body:
You mention a flashing line. The conductor replies: "It appears only to those who know how to ask."

His tone is neutral. But you sense impatience.
strings.styx.s51.c1: Say that you saw the return line
strings.styx.s51.c2: Go ring the bell three times at the ticket window
strings.styx.s52.title: The Ticket
strings.styx.s52.body:
You show the black ticket or its pieces. The conductor does not touch it.

"That is an entry ticket. You need an exit ticket."
strings.styx.s52.c1: Say that the ticket is enough
strings.styx.s53.title: The Platform Corridor
strings.styx.s53.body:
The platform shifts beneath your feet like a very slow moving walkway. The station wants to take you somewhere.

You can fight it... or let yourself be carried.
strings.styx.s53.c1: Resist and look for the exception
strings.styx.s53.c2: Let it guide you toward the red glow
strings.styx.s53.c3: Return to the car, on instinct
strings.styx.s54.title: Assembling the Evidence
strings.styx.s54.body:
Everything falls into place: the frozen time, the return line, the control log, and your black ticket.

You suddenly understand that the station has classified you.
strings.styx.s54.c1: Present the case with the intact ticket
strings.styx.s54.c2: Present the case with the torn ticket
strings.styx.s54.c3: Give up and follow the red glow
strings.styx.h.s54.soft: The exit is not a door: it is a decision.
strings.styx.h.s54.strong: If you have the log + 03:17 + the return line + ticket, you can trigger the white departure.
strings.styx.s55.title: You Can Still Give Up
strings.styx.s55.body:
The fog brushes your ankles. A gentle tiredness promises the end of effort.

You can still choose: fight to get out... or go down for real.
strings.styx.s55.c3: Go back to see the conductor
strings.styx.s56.title: Charon
strings.styx.s56.body:
An old dark man holds a lantern. He does not smile. He does not threaten.

He simply waits. "Coming?"
strings.styx.s57.title: The Price
strings.styx.s57.body:
Charon raises his lantern. "Ticket. Or memory."

His gaze seems to pass through you, as if searching for your exact weight.
strings.styx.s58.title: Cerberus
strings.styx.s58.body:
This time, it is visible: a canine mass with three heads. It does not leap. It guards.

Its breath makes the stone vibrate. It judges you without emotion.
strings.styx.s59.title: The Gates
strings.styx.s59.body: Monumental gates open onto a world of darkness. The cold does not reach you, and shadows are watching.
strings.styx.s60.title: The White Departure
strings.styx.s60.body:
White light floods the rails. A train appears, clearer, more real. Its doors open with a normal sound.

For the first time, the air smells like... outside. The conductor lets you pass without moving.
strings.styx.s60.c2: Hesitate and look at STYX one last time
strings.styx.s60.c3: Return to the cab with a crazy idea
strings.styx.h.s60.soft: The station is letting you go, but it never forgets.
strings.styx.h.s60.strong: If you leave now, that’s the good ending. If you go back, you risk being assigned to it.
strings.styx.s61.title: Platform of Shadows
strings.styx.s61.body:
From the cab, you see a platform full of blurred figures. They wait. They do not speak.

And you understand that the ferryman’s place was never really empty.
strings.styx.h.s61.soft: The station is missing a role. It is looking for a replacement.
strings.styx.h.s61.strong: Cap + activated cab = possibility of becoming the driver of arrivals.
strings.styx.s62.title: Choice of Role
strings.styx.s62.body:
The levers vibrate beneath your fingers. You feel an invisible signature preparing itself: your name, bound to the station.

If you confirm, you will no longer be a passenger.
strings.styx.s63.title: Resist
strings.styx.s63.body:
You turn your eyes away from Lethe. Your brain screams from exhaustion, then steadies.

You remain yourself. For now.
strings.styx.s63.c1: Look for an exit from the basin
strings.styx.s64.title: Erasure
strings.styx.s64.body:
One sip is enough. The world simplifies. The details drift away.

You know you had proof. But you no longer know what it was. You almost smile.
strings.styx.s64.c1: Wander aimlessly, the station guides you
strings.styx.s64.c2: Return to the car, by instinct
strings.styx.s65.title: Directive Fog
strings.styx.s65.body:
The fog grows soft, persuasive. It leads you toward the easiest decision.

You can still fight... or accept being carried.
strings.styx.s66.title: It All Begins Again
strings.styx.s66.body:
You return to the ticket window as if it were the first time. The bell is there. The glass is dirty. The lamp is lit.

Nothing has changed. Or almost nothing.
strings.styx.s67.title: Three Rings
strings.styx.s67.body:
You ring it. Once. Twice. Three times.

On the third, the fog in the waiting room lifts, like a breath returning. And far away, the departure board flickers differently.
strings.styx.s67.c2: Stay at the ticket window and listen
strings.styx.s68.title: The Return Line
strings.styx.s68.body:
The line finally flashes: "RETURN — PLATFORM 0."

It appears only for a second at a time. But you read it. And the station knows you read it.
strings.styx.s68.c1: Write everything down, return and proof
strings.styx.s68.c3: Stay at the board to check the other destinations
strings.styx.h.s68.soft: The station grants you an exception because you respected the ritual.
strings.styx.h.s68.strong: The "return line" is an essential flag: without it, no white departure.
strings.styx.s69.title: Ferryman’s Train
strings.styx.s69.body:
A glowing red tunnel. An ancient train. And Charon... but not on foot.

He is already in the cab, as if this train were his boat.
strings.styx.s69.c1: Go all the way to the cab of shadows
strings.styx.s70.title: Micro-Loop
strings.styx.s70.body:
You blink and return to the same place. The platform, the fog, the silence.

The station is showing you that it can put you wherever it wants. Whenever it wants.
strings.styx.s71.title: One Piece of Evidence
strings.styx.s71.body: The paper is cold in your hand. A few lines, very clear. It may be enough as proof.
strings.styx.s72.title: Last Warning
strings.styx.s72.body:
The conductor is there, like a fixed point. "You hesitate. Then listen: those who hesitate too long end up belonging to the station."

He points to the fog. "It already knows your weight."
strings.styx.end_good.title: END GOOD — Return
strings.styx.end_good.body:
You board. The doors close with a normal sound.

White light swallows the station. Then, all at once, you wake in the real world, on an ordinary train. Passengers are talking, a child is laughing, an announcement crackles overhead.

Your phone shows the time. 03:17 has just passed.

And in your pocket... the ticket is gone.
strings.styx.end_bad.title: Bad Ending — Arrival
strings.styx.end_bad.body:
Charon waits for you as if he has always done this job. Cerberus guards the gate without moving.

At last, you understand: this was never a stop.

It was an arrival.

Behind you, STYX closes its doors and you become one more shadow.
strings.styx.end_secret.title: END SECRET — Driver
strings.styx.end_secret.body:
You take the black cap.

When you put it on, the whole station goes silent.

The trains keep arriving. The figures step down. The platform fills with calm shadows.

This time, you are in the cab.

The lever responds to your hand.

You no longer search for the exit.

You are the one who brings the others in.
